market_summary: Intense downside volatility expansion emerged across markets during the London/NY Overlap cash open, pressing US100, XAUUSD, XAGUSD, and EURUSD directly into major session low support levels. However, lack of yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation across FX and metals, coupled with extreme ATR-band lower envelope overextension and a massive 120-point absorption wick off US100 session lows, flags severe trap risk for late momentum sellers. With BTCUSD and GBPUSD bound inside their session Value Areas, disciplined execution dictates a universal HOLD until post-open liquidity stabilizes.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3879.74) and below POC (3895.33). CVD is BEARISH (-5.24) with a negative slope (-0.53), agreeing with downward price momentum. Evaluated during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price is trading below downward-sloping VWAP (3897.02) and below EMA50 (3893.76). The ATR channel is expanding with price riding near the lower ATR band (3871.20). RVOL is 1.781 on grey bars, lacking the required yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation, which warns of a suspect move. Price cleanly rejected S/R at 3887.45 earlier but is now pressing directly into major support at Session Low (3872.70) without adequate room to short. GEX is null. Confluence favors HOLD to avoid selling into session low support without volume confirmation.
signals.level_event: rejection of S/R 3887.45 and approach to Session Low 3872.70

signals.rationale: Price trades below VAL (1.10507) and below POC (1.10594). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,309.09) with a positive short-term slope (+3,544.11), diverging from the price flush. Evaluated during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price is trading below VWAP (1.10567) and below falling EMA50 (1.10553). Price has breached the lower ATR band (1.10365), reaching an extended volatility stretch. RVOL is 1.203 on grey volume bars, indicating an unconfirmed breakout. The signal candle swept Prev Low (1.10457) and spiked Session Low (1.10349) before stalling. GEX is null. HOLD is warranted due to lower ATR band exhaustion, CVD divergence, and high risk of a mean-reversion snap off session low support.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32252 to VAH 1.32377) and below POC (1.32334). CVD is NEUTRAL (-634.88) with an upward slope (+2,185.09), showing no clear seller aggression. Evaluated during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price trades marginally below VWAP (1.32329) and flat EMA50 (1.32332). Candles are consolidating mid-channel between the upper ATR band (1.32508) and lower ATR band (1.32163). RVOL is 1.240 on normal grey bars, lacking any breakout confirmation. Price remains bounded by S/R support at 1.32247 / Session Low (1.32180) and S/R resistance at 1.32391 / Session High (1.32508). GEX is null. Value area rules strictly favor HOLD for mean-reversion chop.

Price is below VAL (28178.02) and below POC (28257.59). CVD is BEARISH (-5.54) with negative slope (-5.82), agreeing with macro session trend pressure. Evaluated during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price is far below VWAP (28265.82) and falling EMA50 (28235.56). Price at 27752.59 is severely overextended over 200 points below the lower ATR band (27968.96). RVOL is 1.756; applying the US100 caveat where Dukascopy index CFD tick volume rarely prints yellow spikes, volume expanded during the opening waterfall. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (28000.72) and Put Wall #1 (27986.79), with Call Wall #1 overhead at 27866.79 and Put Wall #2 at 27786.79. However, the signal bar printed a massive 120-point absorption wick rejecting Session Low (27629.87) after breaking Prev Low (27912.13). Selling after such extreme ATR extension into a sharp hammer wick carries unacceptable squeeze risk. HOLD is mandatory.

Price is below VAL (49.753) and below POC (49.994). CVD is BEARISH (-220.79) with negative slope (-27.47), agreeing with downward movement. Evaluated during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price trades below VWAP (50.067) and below downward-sloping EMA50 (49.951). Price has broken through the lower ATR band (49.329), signaling a stretched condition. RVOL is 1.339 on grey bars, lacking the required yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation, indicating a suspect breakdown trap. The signal bar broke S/R 49.579 but is sitting immediately atop critical support at Session Low (49.173). GEX is null. HOLD is warranted as selling directly into session low support while extended past the lower ATR band without yellow volume confirmation violates discipline.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 68326.58 to VAH 69569.27) and below POC (69219.76). CVD is BEARISH (-0.09) with a minor negative slope (-0.02), indicating subdued delta. Evaluated during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price is trading below VWAP (69307.38) and below EMA50 (69343.71). Price is consolidating mid-channel in the lower value area above the lower ATR band (68354.68). RVOL is 1.504 on grey bars without yellow RVOL > 2.0 expansion. Price remains well above Session Low (67549.90) and below Prev Low (71031.00) without any structural sweep or level rejection. GEX is null. Value Area rules require HOLD when inside the value area absent an RVOL breakout or clear POC reclaim.
